title: WebhookRequest
description: Request to create a new webhook

webhookUrl.description: The URL where webhook events will be sent

eventTypes.description:
Event types this webhook should receive. A webhook receives an event if, and only if, the event type matches one of these strings **exactly** (case-sensitive).


**Open namespace.** Any lowercase `domain.entity.action` value of 2-4 dot-separated segments is accepted, so you can subscribe to your own events and publish them via POST /webhooks/events without a change to this service.


**Event types published by CertifyOS:**

- `credential_workflow.status.changed` - Triggered automatically when a credentialing workflow status changes (timeline event is created). See webhook-api-credential-workflow-events.md for detailed payload structure and documentation.

- `facility_credential_workflow.status.changed` - Triggered automatically when a facility credentialing workflow status changes.

- `form.submission.submitted` - Triggered when a form submission is received by POST /forms/submissions.

- `roster_job.status.changed` - Triggered when a roster job reaches a client-facing status (PENDING_CORRECTION, PENDING_APPROVAL, IMPORTED, FAILED).

- `facility.global_termination.completed` - Triggered once per facility when a facility global termination (POST /facilities/terminate) completes. Payload: `certifyFacilityId`, `facilityName`, `npi`, `tin`, `terminationDate`, `terminationReason`, `status`. A global termination ends everything the facility has, so there is no per-location detail. `facilityName`, `npi` and `tin` are read from the facility and are `null` when unavailable. 

- `practitioner.terminated` - Triggered when a practitioner is terminated via PUT /practitioners/terminate (any of the 9 `terminationType` values, including `FULL_EXIT`) or by a roster STOP row. Payload: `certifyPractitionerId`, `npi`, `terminationType`, `terminationDate`, `terminationReason`. Keys are always present; a value that is unknown or not applicable is sent as an explicit `null`.

headers.description: Custom headers to include in webhook requests

isActive.description: Whether the webhook is active. Defaults to true if not provided

oauthConfiguration.description: Optional OAuth client-credentials configuration. When provided, a token is minted before each delivery and sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

WebhookOauthConfiguration.description: OAuth client-credentials configuration. When present, a token is fetched before each delivery and injected as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
